title: Lion cub eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#3a4a7a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 78 Q90 74 86 60' stroke='#e8b33c' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='58' r='6' fill='#a86b1e'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='27' ry='18' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='80' width='10' height='10' rx='4' fill='#e0a83a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='80' width='10' height='10' rx='4' fill='#e0a83a'/>
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='90' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#f7d97a'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='90' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#f7d97a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='21' fill='#f2c14e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='26' r='8' fill='#e0a83a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='26' r='4' fill='#f7d97a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='26' r='8' fill='#e0a83a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='26' r='4' fill='#f7d97a'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='42' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#c47a22' stroke-width='5' stroke-dasharray='7 6'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f9e3a8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='38' r='3' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='3' fill='#3a2a10'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='37' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='37' r='1' fill='#fff8dc'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M38 48 L46 48 L42 52 Z' fill='#c46a4a'/>
  <!-- snack: a chunk of meat on a stick -->
  <rect x='52' y='54' width='20' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b07840' transform='rotate(-12 62 56)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='50' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#d9564a'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='48' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ef7a6a'/>
  <!-- paws holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='60' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f7d97a'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='64' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f7d97a'/>
</svg>
